page.layout: One printed page. A narrow column of marginal notes runs down the left side, beside the main text column. Running head at top centre and right, page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right, below the last full line. The neighbouring page at the right edge is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Rempub. aut in Principum personas neutiquàm. Imò, cùm propter loquendi libertatem, ex Imperatoris iussu in exilium relegatus esset, & populum (quem unà cum {b}40. Episcopis sibi habuit devinctissimum) sui gratia tumultuantem conspiceret : veritus (inquit b Niceph. 13.31.{o} Sozomenus) ne quod sibi crimen laesae Majestatis còfictum impingeretur, vel quasi adversus Imperatore fuisseto Lib.8. cap.18. [?] contumax, vel quasi populum concitasset: tertiò post depositionem die, plebe iam dispersa, circa meridiè furtim relinquit Ecclesiam, & ad Occidentalem portam equum suum curans deducendum ipse Orientali egressus est. Legatur eius {p}Homilia antequam iret in exilium.p Hom.11. Bone Deus,quanta ibi unà cum invicto robore animi patientia? [nemo voscontur-bet, Fratres, orate tantùm : non ego proprię virtuti confido,habeo Scripturam Domini mei, manum ipsius teneo, illa mihi cautio satis tuta est, illa me se-curum reddet, & intrepidum. Etiamsi Orbis terrarum cōmoveatur, ego cautionem Domini mei teneo. Vultis vobis recitem Domini Cautionem ; Ecce

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left: "b Niceph. 13.31.", "o Lib.8. cap.18.", "p Hom.11." (each placed at its reference mark in the text). Doubtful readings: "còfictum" (accent over o uncertain); "fuisset" (the long-s/f form is unclear, marked [?]); "Hom.11." (numeral partly obscured). The bracket before "nemo" and the hyphen in "voscontur-bet" are as printed. The word "inquit" at the lower right is the catchword, so it is not in the text.
